description: On-device voice host: libelizainference (llama.cpp/ggml; Paradee-8M TTS with native misaki G2P and eSpeak NG out-of-lexicon fallback, Phonon-2 parakeet-tdt ASR with batch and streaming decode, Silero VAD) through the shared paradee-voice Java API (ai.eliza.voice) and RegisterNatives JNI. The only on-device speech engine; llama.cpp-based, no other neural runtime. These are the exact bytes scripts/android-stage-voice-models.mjs may stage; component evidence is recorded separately from installed-app, hardware audio and user acceptance.

bundle.install: APK assets copied to private storage with SHA-256 verification; Phonon b5x3t7 model is 208,932,352 bytes. No network installation.

asrSlot.current: Pinned Phonon-2/parakeet-tdt model; current native loader selects the in-tree ggml backend. Model architecture and backend registry override are separate.
